items.item: `Sources/Time To Live Store/Store.InMemory.swift`: expired entries keep their capacity sl
items.reason: The existing insert(_:forKey:ttl:) has no current instant, so it cannot know what is expired; added insert(_:forKey:ttl:at:), which prunes entries expired at that instant when the store is full and the key is new, then inserts. The clock-driven insert(_:forKey:expiresIn:) in Time To Live Dependencies now uses it. The instant-less insert is kept (documented as evicting the oldest even if live) to avoid breaking callers.

notes: Store.InMemory now also stores its capacity (private). Tests added in Tests/Time To Live Store Tests/Store.InMemory Boundary Tests.swift. Not fixed, outside the checklist: Store.InMemory(capacity: 0) traps through Cache.Bounded's precondition.
